speakers.title: Leon Stigter
speakers.content:
Leon Stigter is a Sr. Product Manager for Serverless at Lightbend, Leon's focus is to help developers accelerate their serverless journey, leveraging both open source and commercial tools.

He is very passionate and outspoken when it comes to the needs of developers because he believes developers can (help) transform their business by getting the right pieces of information to the right people at the right time in the right context.

acf.speaker_position: Senior Product Manager for Serverless at Lightbend

meta.speaker_position: Senior Product Manager for Serverless at Lightbend

speakers.title: Jorge Vásquez
speakers.content:
Software Developer focused on the backend. He had the chance to work with several technologies and programming languages across different industries, such as Telco, AdTech, and Online Education.

He’s always looking to improve his skills, finding new and better ways to solve business problems. He loves functional programming, and he’s convinced it can help to make better software. Also, he’s excited about new libraries like ZIO that are making Scala FP more accessible to developers.

speakers.title: Paweł Prażak
speakers.content: Cloud Architect @ VirtusLab particularly interested in distributed computing and security. After years of writing backend, middleware software and infrastructure automation, his current focus is DevOpsSec and Cloud-Native platforms. He dreams of replacing himself with software. Addicted to Twitter and coffee.

speakers.title: Martin Odersky
speakers.content: Inventor of the Scala language, a professor at EPFL in Lausanne, Switzerland, and a founder of Lightbend. ACM fellow, co-designer of Java generics, and original author of the current javac reference Compiler.

speakers.title: Dat Tran
speakers.content:
Dat is heading Axel Springer AI, the artificial intelligence unit of Axel Springer SE which is the largest digital publishing house in Europe. His goal is to make AI more accessible within Axel Springer and hence drive innovation within the group. His ultimate plan is to turn Axel Springer into an AI first company.

Dat's interests are diverse from traditional machine learning, deep learning, AI in general to computer vision and NLP. He is a regular speaker and has presented at several renowned conferences. He also blogs about his work on Medium.

acf.speaker_position: Head of AI at Axel Springer

meta.speaker_position: Head of AI at Axel Springer

speakers.title: Sean Walsh
speakers.content:
Field CTO and Cloud Evangelist at Lightbend, and a 20 year veteran of IT and has previously held various leadership roles in the tech industry. Sean is a distributed systems expert and has applied this expertise in the energy, financial and wellness industries, among others. Sean pioneered patterns for microservice integration that have since become standards, formalizing them in his book Reactive Application Development, published by Manning.

Prior to joining Lightbend, he founded a consulting company to evangelize, architect, and implement reactive technologies at major enterprises around the world. This included leading the successful digital transformation of Weight Watchers.

acf.speaker_position: Field CTO and Cloud Evangelist at Lightbend

meta.speaker_position: Field CTO and Cloud Evangelist at Lightbend

speakers.title: Zack Jackson
speakers.content: Principal Engineer at Lululemon, Core maintainer of Webpack and creator of Module Federation. He specializes in distributed javascript orchestration at scale.

acf.speaker_position: Principal Engineer at Lululemon, Core maintainer of Webpack and creator of Module Federation

meta.speaker_position: Principal Engineer at Lululemon, Core maintainer of Webpack and creator of Module Federation

speakers.title: Hubert Pomorski
speakers.content: Hubert Pomorski is Senior Big Data Developer @ VirtusLab, currently supporting client endeavor to scalable, fully automated Machine Learning pipelines in hybrid Hadoop-cloud environment. In free time, Hubert enjoys good board game.

acf.speaker_position: Senior Big Data Developer at VirtusLab

meta.speaker_position: Senior Big Data Developer at VirtusLab

speakers.title: Raul Raja
speakers.content:
Functional programming enthusiast. Self driven software engineer with strong backend Scala experience. Creative problem solving. Design Patterns knowledge. Always looking to try the latest in every technology.

Specialties: Software architecture, Scala, Kotlin, Cats, ScalaZ, Play! Framework and types.

acf.speaker_position: CTO & Co-Founder at 47 Degrees, Arrow Maintainer

meta.speaker_position: CTO & Co-Founder at 47 Degrees, Arrow Maintainer

speakers.title: Marcin Moskala
speakers.content: Marcin Moskala is an experienced developer and Kotlin trainer. He is the founder of the Kt. Academy, an official JetBrains partner for teaching Kotlin, author of the book "Effective Kotlin" and "Android Development with Kotlin", speaker at many international conferences, and programming library creator and contributor.

speakers.title: Yan Cui
speakers.content:
Yan is an experienced engineer who has run production workload at scale in AWS for over 10 years. He has been an architect and principal engineer with a variety of industries ranging from banking, e-commerce, sports streaming to mobile gaming. He has worked extensively with AWS Lambda in production the last 4 years.

Nowadays, he splits his time between advancing the state of serverless observability as a Developer Advocate at lumigo.io and helping companies around the world adopt serverless as an independent consultant.

Yan is also an AWS Serverless Hero and a regular speaker at user groups and conferences internationally. He is also the author of Production-Ready Serverless and co-author of Serverless Architectures on AWS, 2nd Edition, both by Manning. And he keeps an active blog at https://theburningmonk.com and hosts a weekly podcast at https://realworldserverless.com.

acf.speaker_position: AWS Serverless Hero and the author of Production-Ready Serverless

meta.speaker_position: AWS Serverless Hero and the author of Production-Ready Serverless

speakers.title: Jon Pretty
speakers.content:
Jon has been having fun riding the bleeding edge of Scala for over a decade, and he’s not finished yet.

While he’s not travelling the world attending Scala conferences or organizing Scala World, Jon spends his time working on a variety of open-source Scala libraries and providing professional Scala training services.

speakers.title: Marko Letic
speakers.content:
Marko Letic is a front-end engineer, lecturer and data visualization scientist. He is currently leading the front-end team at AVA, a Berlin-based company, where he is working on a platform that combines big data, pattern recognition and artificial intelligence to take the safety of individuals, organizations, cities, and countries to a whole new level. His main role is to create a contextual analysis of the processed data through a web-based client application.

Marko is also working as a Tech Speaker at Mozilla promoting the values of the open web and he is one of the organizers of Armada JS, the first JavaScript conference in Serbia. He holds an MSc degree in Computer Science and is pursuing his PhD in data visualization. He sometimes writes fiction novels that probably will never get published as he spends too much time coding.

acf.speaker_position: Tech Speaker at Mozilla, Lead Front-end Engineer at AVA

meta.speaker_position: Tech Speaker at Mozilla, Lead Front-end Engineer at AVA

speakers.title: Juho Vepsäläinen
speakers.content:
Juho Vepsäläinen is behind the SurviveJS effort. He has been active in the open-source scene since the early 2000s and participated in projects like Blender and web pack as a core team member.
Juho lives in Vienna, Austria, and was chosen as the Finnish Code Ambassador of 2017 by Blue Arrow Awards. He organizes React Finland and GraphQL Finland.

acf.speaker_position: Founder of SurviveJS, JSter, React Finland and GraphQLFinland

meta.speaker_position: Founder of SurviveJS, JSter, React Finland and GraphQLFinland

speakers.title: Daniela Sfregola
speakers.content: Daniela is a Software Engineer based in London, UK. She is an active contributor to the Scala Community, a maintainer of open-source projects, and the author of Get Programming with Scala, by Manning Publications.

speakers.title: Daniel Spiewak
speakers.content: Daniel Spiewak is a Software Developer based out of Boulder, CO. Over the years, he has worked with Scala, Java, Ruby, Haskell, C/C++, SML, Clojure, and countless other languages. He currently spends most of his time maintaining the Cats Effect project and continuing to push the boundaries of what is possible at the intersection of mathematical laws and highly scalable production implementations.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Daniel Spiewak, Principal Engineer at Disney Streaming, speaking at Sphere.it conf 2022 in Krakow, Poland. Topic: Threads at Scale.

speakers.title: Wiem Zine Elabidine
speakers.content: Wiem Zine Elabidine is a Software Engineer. She is enthusiastic about Scala and Functional programming. In her free time, she contributes to a Scala open source projects.

speakers.title: Nicolas Stucki
speakers.content: Software Engineer at EPFL

speakers.title: Sébastien Doeraene
speakers.content: Sébastien Doeraene is a compiler/runtime systems hacker, and the author of Scala.js. He is a Ph.D. student at EPFL in the programming methods laboratory (LAMP), also known as the Scala team. He holds bachelor and master degrees in computer science engineering from Université Catholique de Louvain in Belgium. When he is not busy coding, he sings in choirs and a cappella groups, or rides around on a unicycle.

speakers.title: Darja Jovanovic
speakers.content:
Darja is the Executive Director of the Scala Center. She is known in the Scala community for leading the Scala Improvement Process, organizing educational events such as Scala sprees and ScalaBridge, managing the Scala Days program since 2017, and most recently she organized the 10th anniversary of the Scala Days conference in Lausanne.

Darja’s main occupation (and passion) is everything non-technical that supports and surrounds the Scala technology.

speakers.title: Roman Janusz
speakers.content: Roman is a Scala enthusiast interested mostly in type systems, metaprogramming, functional programming, and distributed systems. He's been writing and teaching Scala at AVSystem for over 5 years now. He’s also done some open source work: silencer plugin for scalac, HOCON plugin for IntelliJ, and their own company’s open-source projects, Udash Framework among them.

speakers.title: Trevor Burton-McCreadie
speakers.content:
After a failed bid at rock stardom, Trevor found solace (and a regular paycheck) writing code. Beginning as a front-end and game developer working with Adobe Flash and Javascript and then moving over to backend development he gradually found himself working more and more on backend development.

Trevor has built systems using Ruby, Python, and Java but now works almost exclusively with Scala and has focused for many years now on systems related to gambling. He lives in the North East of England with his wife, two children, a smart cat, and a stupid dog.

acf.speaker_position: Head of Software Development at Esports Entertainment Group

meta.speaker_position: Head of Software Development at Esports Entertainment Group

speakers.title: Alan Klikić
speakers.content: Alan Klikic is a Senior Solution Architect at Lightbend. He has 15+ years of experience in software development and is passionate about reactive and distributed systems. Prior to Lightbend, Alan was a co-owner and technical lead of Intenda Net, Croatian software company developing in-house software solutions using Lightbend products. Alan holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Zagreb, Croatia and currently resides in the Netherlands with his wife and four children.

speakers.title: Samuel Weiss
speakers.content: Samuel is part of the Global Process and Application Management organizing at DHL Global Forwarding, primarily focusing on strategic initiatives coming from the IT renewal roadmap. He’s an entrepreneur with over a decade of experience in Product, Service, and Business Performance Management started as a software developer 25 years ago. Samuel is passionate about contributing to the success of the company.

acf.speaker_position: Global Process and Application Management at DHL

meta.speaker_position: Global Process and Application Management at DHL

speakers.title: Daniel Madalitso Phiri
speakers.content: Daniel is a Developer Advocate at Strapi, Writer, Builder of Wacky things, DJ, Lorde superfan, and Community Builder from Lusaka, Zambia.

speakers.title: Mateusz Strąg
speakers.content: Mateusz is a Tech Lead at VirtusLab, developing headless CMS consumed by multiple applications, recently focused on building scalable infrastructure in the cloud for various applications. In his free time, he contributes to open source projects, and develops applications within the R & D department. Loves to work on innovative tools, especially those which will improve the developer experience.

speakers.title: Vanessa Otto (Böhner)
speakers.content: Vanessa is a Web Developer. She has an M.Sc in Media Informatics with a focus on Human-Computer-Interaction. Vanessa is the Lead Frontend Developer at Zavvy. She is a host of the podcasts except (Exception), Working Draft, and Ausbaufähig. Until 2021 Vanessa was the Chapter Leader of the Front-end Foxes helping women with their first coding and speaking experiences. She is a member of the JS Kongress Program Committee.

speakers.title: Dorota Lączak
speakers.content: Dorota Lączak is a Software Engineer with 2 years of experience testing and developing on IBM Watson Machine Learning AutoAI components. She is enthusiastic about Python and Data Science topics.

speakers.title: Maria Oleszkiewicz
speakers.content: Maria Oleszkiewicz is a Python & Scala programmer. Currently, she is developing the Python API for IBM Watson Machine Learning. In her free time, she creates unique items using manual skills like hand spinning, knitting, crocheting, and weaving.

speakers.title: Sofiane Fessi
speakers.content: Hi, I'm Sofiane and I have the pleasure of leading a team of brilliant Solutions Architects at Dataiku covering DACH and Eastern Europe.

acf.speaker_position: Head of Sales Engineering at Dataiku

meta.speaker_position: Head of Sales Engineering at Dataiku

speakers.title: Iwona Celińska
speakers.content:
Iwona is a programmer with 12 years of experience. She had the opportunity to get to know many sides of computer science. She had the possibility to learn domain administration, database management, as well as optimization, programming, development, and maintenance of CRM/ERP systems. Currently, she works as a C#/.Net Full Stack Developer at EQTek.

She specializes in developing business applications. Iwona is a powerful force in the workplace and uses her positive attitude and tireless energy to make the work of her team easier. Her motto is "Let's help each other, it will make our lives easier". In her free time, Iwona likes to hike, climb, ride a bicycle, read books and spend time with her friends and family.

speakers.title: Adam Gajek
speakers.content: Adam is a Software Engineer with over seven years of experience, for four years he has been part of the VirtusLab company, where he currently fulfills himself as a Team Lead in the AdStream project. He is passionate about solving problems and improving things. In his spare time, he rides a road bike and reads - as he claims - useless books.

speakers.title: Kamil Stanuch
speakers.content: Co-founder at Sigmapoint software house (acq'd by Grand Parade in 2016). Site Director of Grand Parade part of William Hill. A great lover of statistics and OKRs. In his free time, he runs the newsletter: kamilstanuch.pl/friendzone.

acf.speaker_position: Former Site Director at Grand Parade

meta.speaker_position: Former Site Director at Grand Parade

speakers.title: Menaka Basker
speakers.content: Working as Senior Programmer, Menaka is a tech enthusiastic blogger and an international speaker who speaks about Cloud and .Net core. Menaka spends her valuable time learning and sharing her knowledge with the community. She is also a former Microsoft Student Partner and Mozilla Firefox student Ambassador. She is a Microsoft certified Resource in Azure and programming in c#. Menaka is recognized as the Most valuable professional by the C# corner community.

speakers.title: Bartłomiej Płotka
speakers.content: Bartek Plotka is a Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat with a background in SRE, currently working on Observability. As the co-author of the CNCF Thanos project and core maintainer of various open-source projects including Prometheus, he enjoys building OSS communities and maintainable, reliable distributed systems, ideally in Go. CNCF Ambassador. On top of that, he is active in the CNCF SIG Observability as the technical lead. He writes a book with O'Reilly.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Principal Engineer at Red Hat at the Sphere.it conf 2022 - Clouds are not Free: Guide to Observability-Driven Efficiency Optimizations.

speakers.title: Harshitha Chowdary Thota
speakers.content: Harshitha Chowdary is a Software Development Engineer at Amazon. She enjoys contributing to open source development and she was a past Google Summer of Code student at Thanos.

speakers.title: Jan Pluta
speakers.content:
Programmer, entrepreneur, co-founder and CTO of Therapify, a mental health care platform. Experienced in developing mobile-first platforms, he specializes in the tools of the Google Cloud ecosystem and the Kotlin language. He took his first steps in the IT industry in a software house, developing mobile applications for the financial sector, retail and e-commerce, to finally find himself in the startup industry.

In the meantime, he was developing new projects after hours, he was a mentor to a group of young programmers. One of his projects turned into full-time work on his own business. In his work, he prefers a pragmatic, iterative approach to software development, always keeping in mind the business goals of the project. Privately, a fan of mountain expeditions and strategy games.

speakers.title: Adrianna Woltmann
speakers.content:
Data analyst with 8 years of experience in quantitative research and 6 in SaaS product companies (Zendesk, Brainly). Currently working as Senior Business Data Analyst in Profitroom where I work with all stakeholder levels on making data-driven decisions and set up processes around data.

Mentor in three editions of TechLeaders and experienced public speaker. I will walk you through the valley of data from basics of data engineering through data preparation and analysis to reporting and visualization. I fear not of experimentation and statistics. Favourite breakfast: hypoteses.

speakers.title: Maya Shavin
speakers.content:
Maya is Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, MDE, GDE on Web performance, Nuxtjs Ambassador, founder of VueJS Israel, core maintainer of StorefrontUI, and a writer on JavaScript good practices. She likes working with ReactJS but always has a Vue in her heart.

She loves to learn and experiment with new frameworks while believing that strong Vanilla JavaScript knowledge is necessary for being a good web developer. When not coding, she enjoys traveling, reading manga, and sketching.

speakers.title: Tomasz Piechaczek
speakers.content: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working with front-end technologies. In his free time enjoys contributing to community projects and playing retro video games.

speakers.title: Monika Soja
speakers.content:
I believe that UX is all about the people and that a great user experience creates a powerful bond between the user and the product.
I am a Senior UX/UI Designer & Information Architect, usually optimizing vast, complex information systems at the enterprise level. I am passionate about solving problems, asking the right questions, and taking a holistic view of a project. All to create solutions tailored to user needs, business requirements, and technical affordances. I enjoy making things simpler and easier or just better and more fun. I adore dogs, naps, travel, and cooking. During recent years I’ve been wearing a hat of a team leader, design lead, and recently, a mentor. I’m a big fan of Witcher Books and LOTR :)

speakers.title: Tomasz Manugiewicz
speakers.content:
Tomek is an Agile enthusiast and Coach, Engineer at heart. Former Engineering Manager, Scrum Master and Software Developer. Tomek conducted his first Agile Transformation in 2009. He worked for various international IT companies and lived in Vienna, Toronto, and the Isle of Man. Passionate about how people relations influence Software Development. He uses his empathy, connectedness, and restorative talents (based on Gallup's taxonomy) to help development teams boost their productivity and individual well-being.

He is known for giving others a sense of comfort and stability in the face of uncertainty. His ability to link together the facts and dots gives him a feeling that he would have been a good doctor or detective - he is happy that he decided to study Computer Science though. Tomek loves skiing, biking, and sailing. Recently he has started his journey as a lecturer at AGH University of Science and Technology leading courses he designed for future engineers.

acf.speaker_position: General Manager at Grand Parade Poland

meta.speaker_position: General Manager at Grand Parade Poland

speakers.title: Marcin Złakowski
speakers.content: A Computer Science student and a Scala Developer at VirtusLab. Waiting for generics to be reified.

speakers.title: Paweł Lipski
speakers.content:
Scala/DevOps Engineer @ VirtusLab, with an inclination towards automating software development processes. 

Currently maintaining VirtusLab open source projects: git-machete, aka "probably the sharpest git repository organizer & rebase workflow automation tool you've ever seen", git-machete-IntelliJ-plugin and working on the alpha version of Akka-serialization-helper.

speakers.title: Zbyszek Królikowski
speakers.content: Zbigniew is a Software Development Engineer at VirtusLab. He works on bringing ML recommendations and re-ranking models onto production, both in private and public clouds.

speakers.title: Joanna Sendorek
speakers.content: Joanna is a Software Development Engineer at VirtusLab. She works on developing a framework for data forecasting and its deployment to the Hadoop cluster. She is particularly interested in delivering end-to-end data processing solutions.

speakers.title: Aleksandrs Gehsbargs
speakers.content:
I am a Data Science soldier and leader. Machine Learning, Statistics, Causal Inferences, Data Visualization, Behavioral Economics all excite and inspire me to broaden my knowledge and skills, to support business, and to inspire others to do the same. With about 10 years of experience in the industry, I was lucky to master most of what is called 'Data Science' today - I built machine learning models, saw how they improved business processes, got into depths of statistical data analysis, and tried to disentangle tricky causal relationships.

Today I am even luckier as I lead a team of talented data scientists. Together we learn how to make inferences from data, and how to support business and improve products. And we never forget that it is always about enjoying the journey - journey in the exciting world of data science!

acf.speaker_position: Data Science Tech Lead at Product Madness

meta.speaker_position: Data Science Tech Lead at Product Madness

speakers.title: Mira Melhor
speakers.content:
As a seasoned UX Manager and Project Manager at VirtusLab, Mira empowers her teams to develop intuitive and impactful user experiences for large-scale corporate projects. Her collaborative leadership style has fostered an environment of shared creativity and collective ownership of projects for over a decade.
With a hands-on approach to mentorship and project guidance, she champions a culture of continuous learning and open communication. Her career is marked by her dedication to aligning technological innovation with human-centric design, ensuring every project resonates with users and serves the community's needs. Through her commitment to both professional development and compassionate service, Mira exemplifies the balance of strength and empathy in modern leadership.

speakers.title: Szymon Sobczak
speakers.content:
Założyciel i CTO w Solvbot - firmie wytwarzającej oprogramowanie z dziedziny LegalTech. Spędził kilka lat w Dolinie Krzemowej, pracując m. in. w Google. Wcześniej architekt systemów Big Data, teraz zajmuje się tematyką startupów, zarządzania produktem i budowania zespołu. Studiował informatykę, biochemię i zarządzanie.

Zaczął programować zawodowo w 2007 i w swojej karierze pisał kod produkcyjny w języku PHP, C++, C (embedded), Go, Ruby, R, JavaScript i Python. Hobbystycznie kolarz, fotograf i memolog.

speakers.title: Szymon Barabasz
speakers.content: Szymon to UX designer i analityk w lubelskim Industi. Na codzień zajmuje się tworzeniem dedykowanych systemów IT. Jest z produktami od pierwszych koncepcji i pomaga klientom doprecyzować zakres i wymagania, po działające rozwijane rozwiązania. W pracy w software housie najbardziej ceni sobie różnorodność i poznawanie coraz to ciekawszych i bardziej wymagających projektów, często z nietypowych branż. Cyfryzował już urzędy, hale produkcyjne i magazynowe, szkoły i kościoły. W tak zmiennym środowisku, kluczowy jest rozwój, codziennie uczy się czegoś nowego i chętnie dzieli się swoją wiedzą.

acf.speaker_position: UX Designer & Business Analyst at Industi

meta.speaker_position: UX Designer & Business Analyst at Industi

speakers.title: Bartosz Siwiński
speakers.content: Python developer on a continuous quest to learn new technologies. Previously, industrial controllers programmer and a test engineer in embedded. Passionate about Industrial Automation, Data Science and always on the lookout for process efficiencies. In private, family guy and boardgame enthusiast.

speakers.title: Maciek Gołaszewski
speakers.content: Maciek is a Cloud Engineer at VirtusLab with over five years of experience. He started out as a tester, maintaining the test environment at AWS. Later, he took the role of an administrator, managing company servers and resources in public clouds. Then he worked as a developer in a team creating tooling for ~ 1000 users, Currently, he is creating the IaaC platform on Azure.

speakers.title: Szymon Fugas
speakers.content: Szymon graduated as an IT engineer at AGH University in Krakow. He's also a student of Japanese at the Jagiellonian University, a member of IAESTE AGH and the AI Lab science club. Szymon started his career developing products for monitoring servers and web applications, and later an application for scheduling nurses' work. He is currently working on Operator Service for Jenkins - a cloud-native solution that manages Jenkins on Kubernetes. Automation and open source enthusiast.

speakers.title: Michał Pałka
speakers.content: Michał is a Senior Scala Tooling Developer @ VirtusLab with more than 6 years of commercial experience in writing Scala applications. For the last year, he's been a part of the core team responsible for the development of the official Scala 3 compiler in close collaboration with Martin Odersky, EPFL, and Scala Center.

acf.speaker_position: Senior Scala Developer at Scala Tooling, VirtusLab

meta.speaker_position: Senior Scala Developer at Scala Tooling, VirtusLab

speakers.title: Kamil Duda
speakers.content:
Kamil is a Scala Engineer at VirtusLab, previously Senior DevOps Engineer, and then Domain Architect at ING Tech Poland. Currently, in his work, he deals with the creation of a global shipment tracking system based on microservices.

He started his professional career in IT during his studies, in 2016. So far I have had the opportunity to write production applications in C #, Java, Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript that work with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Hobbies: electric guitar, music theory, canine behavior.

speakers.title: Michał Nieć
speakers.content:
Michal graduated with a Master's in Computer Science from Krakow's AGH University. Artificial intelligence and adaptive systems have interested Michal since his college days, and he still finds the time to scratch that itch. Michal has consulting experience in a wide range of industries including enterprise-grade messaging with MongooseIM, digital advertising, and online gaming.

As the CEO of Appliscale Michal is developing a technology consulting firm that partners with top US and EU tech companies helping them to develop cutting-edge products and technologies. Michal is a big advocate of agile, lean, and transparent organizations where the focus is on self-management and knowledge growth.

speakers.title: Kamila Gawrońska
speakers.content:
Kamila is a biomedical engineer, electronics engineer, and project manager by education. She believes that everyone is able to learn anything if they really want it. During her almost 10 years of activity in the IT world, she was a software tester, business analyst, UX designer, and project manager.
She gained experience in research and development projects in the area of construction, automotive, medical and smart city industries. For many years, she has been sharing her knowledge during various industry events. She likes to question the status quo and conduct verbal fencing on arguments supported by hard data, for which the teams she works with either like or hate her. As befits a girl from a polytechnic university, she likes beer in the company of strict minds.

speakers.title: Agnieszka Lasyk
speakers.content: Agnieszka is an experienced manager, for almost 10 years in the IT industry. Passionate about process improvement, good feedback, and psychological safety in the organization. Leader-mentor who, under various initiatives, helps women enter the technology industry. She likes working with people and supporting them in their development, building teams, and changing the organization for the better. She believes in the power of trust and empathy.

speakers.title: Dominika Glazer
speakers.content: A historian by education and passion, professionally - a manager. In the IT industry since 2016, she has managed projects, products, and teams. Currently, as Senior Product Manager @ VirtusLab, Dominika coordinates the work of the product team and develops a vision of a product based on one of the fuels driving modern business systems, which is data.

speakers.title: Anita Warkiewicz
speakers.content: Talenti Team member responsible for products and technological innovation. Certified Scrum Master and Agile Coach, an expert in leadership, management, and Agile methodologies and processes. Co-founder of Agile conferences, podcaster, and blog author on best management practices. Mentor at such programs as “Mamo Pracuj w IT” or “Tech Leaders”. Since 2013 in IT, and for several years also in the tax industry. Passionate about new technologies, psychology, and business development, especially start-ups. Privately Cracovian by choice, loves cooking and eating yummy food, developing business competencies, and trying new sports.

speaker_avatar.title: Fotografia Biznesowa Kraków
speaker_avatar.caption: Fotografia biznesowa; zdjecia biznesowe; sesja biznesowa, sesja biznesowa krakow, fotograf biznesowy Kraków, fotografia korporacyjna; Fotografia portretowa; portret; fotograf Kraków, sesja portretowa; kraków, Iwaszko fotografia, zdjęcia portretowe, Piotr Iwaszko, Ania Iwaszko, Iwaszko Fotografia
speaker_avatar.name: fotografia-biznesowa-krakow

speakers.title: Karolina Wasielewska
speakers.content: Karolina is a radio and press journalist and the author of the “Girls Gone Tech” blog. Currently, she publishes and reads news on Radio Złote Przeboje (Agora SA). She also runs a blog and a related fan page on Facebook devoted to the history of women in science and technology, and she published her first book "Cyfrodziewczyny" - a reportage about the female pioneers of Polish IT.

acf.speaker_position: journalist, author of “Girls Gone Tech” blog

meta.speaker_position: journalist, author of “Girls Gone Tech” blog

speakers.title: Wojciech Mazur
speakers.content: Wojciech Mazur is a Scala Tooling Engineer at VirtusLab with many years of commercial experience in projects using Scala. For the last 2 years, he has been responsible for the maintenance and development of Scala Native - a compiler and runtime environment for Scala-based on LLVM, in close cooperation with Scala Center and EPFL.

speakers.title: Sebastian Kister
speakers.content: Sebastian is Product Team Lead; Kubernetes Competence Center and Lead of CNCF Partnership at Audi AG. He is a digital transformation evangelist with a strong focus on culture and tech, successfully combining start-up and enterprise experience. He is dramatically result-driven, creating best-of-breed solutions to enable organizations and innovate holistically between people, processes and tools. Constantly challenging the status quo he always strives for the big picture to once again boldly go where no one has gone before.

acf.speaker_position: Product Team Lead: Kubernetes Competence Center at Audi AG

meta.speaker_position: Product Team Lead: Kubernetes Competence Center at Audi AG

speakers.title: Mikołaj Klaman
speakers.content: A software engineer with a JVM background who converted to the frontend side but never felt comfortable without static typing. He is interested in taking various concepts or techniques from the FP folk and trying to apply them in practice in a way that does not annoy too many people but helps achieve readable and maintainable code. He is impeded mostly by his perfectionist tendencies, nothing that can't be fixed with a little bit of workaholism.

speakers.title: Łukasz Wroński
speakers.content: CEO, developer, hacker, father of two, bass player, internet troll, and meme enthusiast… 14 years in IT seems not to be enough time to lose the ability to get excited and surprised with new technologies!

acf.speaker_position: CEO at Purple Deer Software Studio

meta.speaker_position: CEO at Purple Deer Software Studio

speakers.title: Mike Wojtyna
speakers.content: Mike is a Java software developer with a passion for creating great products. Domain-driven design & Test-driven development are some of his favorite tools. His code is clean and easy to modify, thanks to the modular, loosely coupled design achieved by continuous TDD iterations backed by a deep understanding of business requirements. Mike is also a professional consultant and trainer. Recently he has created an interactive training program to help you become a professional software developer.

speakers.title: Aga Szóstek
speakers.content:
Aga Szóstek, Ph.D. is a strategic designer and author of the books "The Umami Strategy" and "Leadership by Design". For the last two decades, she has worked with leading companies combining design, technology, and business. She also mentors leaders and management in the field of strategic change.

In addition to consulting, Aga designs tools to support the delivery of unique experiences as well as undergoing personal and professional transformations and co-hosts a leadership podcast: Catching The Next Wave. She is also the founding partner of the World Experience Organization.

acf.speaker_position: Strategic Experience Designer, author of "The Umami Strategy" & "Leadership by Design"

meta.speaker_position: Strategic Experience Designer, author of "The Umami Strategy" & "Leadership by Design"

speakers.title: Adam Warski
speakers.content:
I am one of the co-founders of SoftwareMill, where I code mainly using Scala and other interesting technologies. I am involved in open-source projects, such as sttp, tapir, Quicklens, ElasticMQ, and others. I have been a speaker at major conferences, such as JavaOne, LambdaConf, Devoxx, and ScalaDays.

Apart from writing closed- and open-source software, in my free time, I try to read the Internet on various (functional) programming-related subjects. Any ideas or insights usually end up in a blog.

speakers.title: Dominika Zając
speakers.content: Full-stack developer who loves sharing their knowledge and singing. Google Developer Expert for Web Technologies, senior software engineer at Qualtrics, public speaker, trainer and blogger. Speaking and writing about Web, a11y, teaching others how to code and code best practices. Privately, huge fan of singing.

speakers.title: Wojtek Gawroński
speakers.content: Wojtek is a Senior Developer Advocate at AWS dedicated for Central and Eastern European (CEE) region. Working with Cloud Computing and Data Engineering since 2015 - in different roles: starting from IT Operations Engineer, Software Engineer and Cloud Architect. Functional programming and Serverless architecture aficionado. 9x Certified AWS Specialist. Speaker, lecturer, and content creator.

speakers.title: Aga Myśliwczyk
speakers.content:
For 20 years as a leader, business partner and entrepreneur, I have been cooperating with companies and employees, bringing above-average benefits to both parties.
On a daily basis, I talk to the owners of technology businesses about their recruitment and needs in the field of building the employer brand (EB) in the Polish market.
I'm the founder of the boutique IT recruitment agency called CandidFuture, a recruiter of managerial and c-level staff, a mentor for IT Recruiters and co-founder of the IT career academy called CandidAcademy.
In 2019, I brought to life the FAIRit - a re-industry program for women under the patronage of infoShare Academy. Thanks to this, 14 out of 19 participants started working as Java or Frontend programmers within three months after finishing.

speakers.title: Magdalena Kunat-Ciunowicz
speakers.content: Magdalena is a software engineer with over 15 years of experience in professional software development that decided to switch to a managerial path last year. Her experience ranges from being a full stack developer, working on test automation, to working directly with the customer. She genuinely believes in the power of teamwork. She likes to spend her free time actively and close to nature. Above all, she is a mother of two girls that are her great inspiration.

speakers.title: Iwona Masłoń
speakers.content:
Iwona is a seasoned IT professional with over 17 years of experience in the tech industry. She has a strong focus and expertise in the areas of programming, databases, IT infrastructure and services, cyber security, and risk management. Throughout her career, Iwona has progressed from administrative positions to management roles at major companies, where she has overseen delivery, customer service, and people and operation areas. Currently, she is holding the role of Business Risk Director at UBS, where she’s responsible for overseeing various strategic initiatives and projects. 

Iwona graduated from the Czestochowa University of Technology with a degree in Mechanical Engineering and Computer Science. She is a certified project manager and ITIL Expert. As a member of the Women in Technology and Women Together groups, she shares her expertise on career path development with her peers. She is a passionate advocate of modern tech and is constantly learning and expanding her business knowledge. Iwona has combined her professional development with social and private pursuits and hobbies. She is a volunteer leader in various activities, is an avid athlete, and loves to run, anything fitness, and go-karting.

She will undertake any implementation: from creating a creation to implementing simple codes. She likes to delve into data. Problems inspire her to find new solutions.
She is not a programmer, but IT has always been her way. She participated in many digital projects, also assisting IT with system or data migration. A fan of new solutions and the use of tools to improve teamwork.

speakers.title: Jennifer Bower
speakers.content:
Jennifer Bower is a delivery leader who embraces personal growth and professional development through failure. With a focus on nurturing relationships and leveraging diverse teams, she is passionate about building, and continuously developing, teams.

As a Country Lead for Persistent Systems, Jennifer fosters a culture of continuous learning. Her unwavering belief in learning from failure has shaped her into a resilient and adaptable leader, inspiring teams to view setbacks as opportunities for growth. She encourages analysis of mistakes, extraction of lessons learned, and implementation of positive changes for continuous evolution and outstanding results.

speakers.title: Dawid Ostręga
speakers.content:
Dawid Ostręga is an IT engineer, Business Leader, Head Coach, Scout Master, and Keynote Speaker. He is specializing in building teams, set up from scratch four software development centers in Krakow, and managed in such firms as EPAM System, IBM, SolarWinds, and SKK. He is most passionate about identifying and developing the personal potential of people on the team.
For 20 years, he obtained experience outside Poland with the intention of bringing it back. After graduating in London, he accepted a scholarship to Wesley College in the USA to do an MBA.
At that time, he could already boast about leading a scout group, his own company, and the champions of England in American football. Even today, he loves to combine various worlds: sport, scouting, and business, in order to transfer experiences and managerial “lessons” between them.
Dawid is linked to Leaders Island through his passion for training leaders by practitioners. He shares his successes (and also failures) during various speeches to create a space for the development of the next leaders in our country.

speakers.title: Monika Starzyk
speakers.content:
Monika is a neuropsychologist building tools, frameworks and educational content for mental and emotional optimization, strengths-based performance and career building as well as brain-health longevity. In the past, she used to be a professional athlete, partner at a fast-growing startup (Base, acquired by Zendesk), as well as a manager of the Google Developers Experts global community program at Google.

Currently at ReWorked, she helps teams and individuals with assessing their strengths, blind spots, naming their unique tactics and quickly putting the theory into action for better effectiveness, cooperation, leadership and - last but definitely not least - satisfaction at work.

speakers.title: Wiktoria Gromowa-Cieślik
speakers.content: Wiktoria is a leader with more than 10 years' experience in IT within the banking area. Having a mathematical background, she worked in areas with automating mathematical and financial models, always hands-on lead and manager. Wiktoria is a devoted fan of technology and shares her passion in each place she is in by leading technology streams within and outside companies, gathering experts to develop innovative solutions and actively supports women in technology. She is open-minded, likes to learn and share her experience.

speakers.title: Bart Kiszala
speakers.content:
Bart Kiszala is an Entrepreneur and Angel Investor who started his first software business when he was 22. A few years later he co-founded Base CRM and worked on a product for 10 years as the CPO till 2018 when the company was acquired by Zendesk. Among other things, they managed to:

  • Convince tens of thousands of salespeople to use Base
  • Introduce Base to companies where hundreds of employees used our software daily
  • Build an incredible team of 200+ people
  • Raise more than 50M USD in 4 rounds of financing
  • Run a tight operation between the two main offices, Krakow and Silicon Valley
  • Scale production, tech, sales, marketing, finance, HR, and customer success
  • Get acquired and become a gate for Zendesk to enter the sales software market

Throughout my career, I have cultivated a deep passion for optimising processes, fostering effective stakeholder collaboration, and ensuring the well-being of my teams, all of which have directly contributed to the delivery of high-quality products. My current mission is to empower and amplify leadership potential in others.

Having work experience in various fields and technologies gave him great foundations to explore broader roles on an enterprise level and various leadership paths. Professional career is never ending journey which gives him continuous joy and development way outside of his technical expertise.

speakers.title: Gabrielle Bufrem
speakers.content:
Gabrielle Bufrem is a product leadership coach. She partners with product leaders and founders to build products and teams people love that drive real business results. She also runs a course on building impactful products. Gabrielle has trained hundreds of product managers, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, for over four years through Mind the Product. She is a speaker at conferences around the world, where she talks about product leadership, decision-making, and building impactful products. Previously, she was the head of product at Little Otter Health - a mental health for kids startup that raised over 22M. Before Little Otter, Gabrielle built products and product teams across 3 continents and 9 industries.  


Gabrielle is originally from Brazil. She speaks four languages fluently (Portuguese, English, French, and Spanish) and has lived across South America, Europe, and Asia, and now lives in New York City. She loves advising startups, coaching product teams, giving keynotes, and writing about products. When she’s not building products, she loves to dance, cook, and travel the world, and she absolutely adores a good cup of coffee - flat whites are her favourite.

speakers.title: Olgica Strezoska
speakers.content:
From a young banker to a respected IT professional, Olgica's journey showcases that with self-belief, you can learn anything and achieve everything. She kicked off her career at 19, exploring various industries and gaining a diverse set of skills along the way.
Today, Olgica is the Principal Product Owner at Damilah, a British company. She also serves as a Mentor and Instructor at a Macedonian Academy for Project and Product Management.

With over 9 years in the IT industry, Olgica places a strong emphasis on understanding the needs of customers, team members, and students. She believes empathy is key to creating successful products and ensuring students are content. As a certified Agile professional and Design Thinking practitioner, Olgica actively incorporates creative and user-centric methods to drive innovation and develop satisfying solutions. Beyond her success in IT, she is committed to sharing her expertise and knowledge with younger colleagues and those transitioning from different industries, understanding the importance of mentorship in guiding others towards their professional goals.

speakers.title: Apurva Misra
speakers.content:
Apurva Misra, an accomplished Senior Machine Learning Engineer, blends her passion for technology with a talent for teaching. With a rich history of conducting engaging AI workshops across the US and Canada, she brings both expertise and enthusiasm to the learning experience. Apurva holds a Master’s degree from the University of Waterloo, where she delved into the intriguing crossroads of driving technology and machine learning in her research.

Her interest doesn't stop at academia; she's also deeply involved in the start-up ecosystem, consulting for start-ups and always eager to engage in conversations about the latest tech developments, as highlighted in TechCrunch.

Outside of her professional pursuits, Apurva is an avid culinary explorer, always on the lookout for those unique, hidden dining spots. Don't hesitate to share your favourite eatery with her - she'd love to hear about it!

speakers.content:
Hila Fish is a DevOps Tech Lead, with over 15 years of experience in the tech industry.AWS Community Builder, Hashicorp Ambassador, and an international public speaker who believes the DevOps culture is what drives a company to perform at its best and talks about that and other DevOps/Infrastructure topics at conferences. 

She carries the vision to enhance and drive business success by taking care of its infrastructure. In her spare time, Hila is a lead singer of a cover band, giving back to the community by co-organizing DevOps-related conferences (Inc. "DevOpsDays TLV" & "StatsCraft" monitoring-focused event), providing mentorship and managing programs in “Baot” (The largest Israeli technical women’s community), and enjoys sharing her passion and knowledge wherever she can, including across diverse technology communities, initiatives and social media.

speakers.title: Paulina Kozub-Chwastek
speakers.content: Indologist. Orientalist with a South Asia Studies diploma (Hindi language specialization) and an International Relations Master's Degree graduate. Business Trainer with a strong focus on intercultural communication with India, leading cross-cultural trainings and consulting for big corporations, IT companies, start-ups, manufacturers, international agencies, and other organizations that work on an international level. IT Marketing and Partnerships professional. Focused on getting in-depth knowledge of CTOs’ (and other tech leaders’) perspectives.

My passion lies in collaborating with individuals and teams to think creatively and innovatively, leveraging both conventional and unconventional methods to tackle complex challenges with confidence. An avid book club enthusiast, constantly seeking out new and exciting concepts to explore and share with others. I strongly believe in the power of lively and engaging discussions to inspire and motivate others to unlock their full potential and achieve greatness. The lead of an employee resource group dedicated to gender equality. In a private life - mother of two kids.

Blending hands-on creativity with automation, I lead personalized workshops and group trainings to solve complex business challenges. While I like efficient laziness, and I champion efficiency, I'm not afraid to get gritty and think outside the box. I find balance escaping the digital world on my road bike, though my love of chocolate remains - no matter what my diabetes has to say.

speakers.title: Luiza Lipień
speakers.content:
Owner of Agile Studio

With over 17 years of experience in IT, Luiza has held a variety of roles from PMO Manager,
Scrum Master, Engineering Manager to Head of Agile Transformation. Thanks to this, she
has gained knowledge in both traditional and Agile approaches, as well as firsthand
experience in setting up environments in which individuals and teams can succeed.

Luiza is a certified ICF coach, Design Thinking moderator, OKRs coach and licensed
Management 3.0 trainer. She shares her experiences and knowledge across Agile
communities, speaking at various conferences and events. Additionally, she is a University
Lecturer at AGH University of Krakow, teaching business management and digital
transformation. She has also served as a mentor in LeadIT Lady, ScrumDzielnia, and
Women in Agile mentoring programs, as well as being a facilitator in the #Iamremarkable
initiative.

As an experienced consultant and trainer in modern leadership and management
practices, Luiza owns Agile Studio – a consulting company whose mission is to help
business professionals adopt Lean, Agile, HR, and personal development best practices.

speakers.title: Magdalena Okrzeja
speakers.content: I’m a co-founder of an early-stage startup, responsible for Product and Engineering. Having 15+ years of experience in different IT roles from developer to engineering manager. Worked for companies like GE Healthcare and Qualtrics where I was building software development teams. I spent the first half of my career years in the data & analytics field, then moved to building software and leading dev teams. Having overall experience in building analytical software gives me a good perspective on how to turn product vision into real software solutions. I’m also an MBA Candidate (grad 2025) at SGH Warsaw University where I’m trying to gain knowledge on the business side of things.

speakers.title: Ola Jacukowicz
speakers.content: Talent & Capability Business Partner at 888 William Hill. A seasoned leadership development specialist with a background in organizational and health psychology. Coach, trainer, public speaker and skilled facilitator. Passionate about developing leaders and teaching them how to use the power of psychology to boost their resilience and confidence to build high-performing and engaged teams. For a couple of years, served as a leader and mentor in Toastmasters, a nonprofit educational organization dedicated to helping people learn and practice the art of public speaking and leadership. Prior to moving to the world of L&D, worked as a researcher in the field of health and work psychology. In 2018, earned a PhD for her thesis on psychosocial risks in the workplace and their impact on health.

speakers.title: Aga Naplocha
speakers.content: Aga Naplocha is a co-founder of Design Practice – an initiative publishing online courses 💻 on digital design and gathering community of over 17k creatives (!) 🤘. ✏️ Her background is UX design and front-end dev. She’s also a popular teacher on Skillshare, teaching how to use coding in a creative way. In her free time, she cycles a lot and runs a newsletter called The Awwwesomes with over 9k subscribers 💌. Feel free to visit Aga on her Instagram and Twitter.

Inspired by the system thinking approach from “The Fifth Discipline” by Peter Senge. She was mentor in Tech Leaders and Scrumdzielnia. speakers.title: Nesrine Changuel
speakers.content:
Nesrine Changuel is an independent product coach and product advocate who's been helping product leaders and spreading product knowledge for over a decade. Nesrine is passionate about technology and defines herself as agile at heart. She is a strong believer in continuous improvement to build successful products.

Nesrine started her career as a research engineer at Bell Labs Nokia in Paris where she published multiple journal papers and technological patents. She moved to product management to start as a product manager at Skype as part of Microsoft in Stockholm. At Skype, Nesrine was responsible for the platform growth including integrating Skype to HoloLens devices and interoperability with Microsoft Teams. After four years at Skype, Nesrine then moved to Spotify, where she led multiple products such as video podcasts and media quality. She helped scaling up Spotify with new formats and enabled supporting new devices and platforms. After four years at Spotify, Nesrine moved to Google, where she started working on the Google Meet product with the mission of providing the best delightful user experience on Meet. Nesrine moved then to Paris to work on Chrome on iOS where she managed new product challenges such as combining productivity and delight for B2C products. 

Nesrine got to address several aspects of product management challenges with products at different stages and scales. She loves using her product expertise in helping others flourish and building a better product environment around them.

Nesrine travelled to conferences around the world to deliver talks on the dynamic topic of Product Management. As a speaker, she balances inspiration with information, providing both theory and practical takeaways.

Nesrine is also lecturer, where she taught courses on product management at different academic institutions such as INSEAD, HEC and Product School. 

Nesrine is based in Paris

speakers.title: Karolina Krawczyk
speakers.content:
I am a CMO & business generalist, people & organisational culture leader, strategist & agent of transformations. Within a 15-year career path I have gained experience in premium & luxury goods, beauty & fashion sectors; both in b2b and b2c model, brick-and-mortar, and eCommerce. My international expertise spans 40+ markets.  

I have graduated from the University of Warsaw, Oxford Business School, IMD Business School, and hold MBA & MCIM status. I had been gaining experience among others in Sephora and L'Oreal, and currently as Marketing Director Eastern Europe in Pandora.

I am often seen wearing suits (and maximal minimalism they express). Underneath a suit I merge passion for contemporary art, industrial rock and jazz… with yoga and zen meditation practices. As both privately and professionally I believe that only a wide spectrum of perspectives and experiences bring us closer to conscious living and a sense of fullness.

I'm also a rare programming languages huntress, I've studied async Rust back when its design was but a blog note and used Fortran 66 in 21st century. Having said that, I'm hardly a loner - I teach, I mentor, I lead. And when the day is over, I grab some dice and play role-playing games. speakers.title: Kinga Gruszecka
speakers.content:
Kinga Gruszecka serves as the President of the Polish Space Professionals Association (PSPA). With a rich background in supporting space technology development and education.

During her tenure as the Director of Education at POLSA from 2019 to 2021, she focused on training and nurturing talent for the space industry. Her expertise spans satellite communications, Earth observation, and other critical aspects of space exploration. She has received numerous accolades, including the “Hope of the Polish Space Sector” award in the "Konstelacje competition" (2019) and recognition as one of the “TOP100 Space & Aerospace Professionals to Follow on LinkedIn” (2023).

Kinga Gruszecka holds a bachelor’s degree in international relations and cultural studies and a master’s degree in management. Her commitment to continuous learning led her to complete postgraduate studies in leadership and organizational culture at the Leon Koźmiński Academy (ALK). Notably, she also lectured in postgraduate programs focused on entrepreneurship in the space sector at ALK.

In 2023, Dr. Gruszecka was honored with a fellowship from the U.S. Department of State and participated in the Distinguished Humphrey Fellowship Program. Her unwavering dedication to the space industry began in 2016, and she continues to be a driving force in advancing space exploration and innovation.

Passionate about communication, design, strategical business development and ADR. speakers.title: Dominika Laboubee
speakers.content:
Dominika Laboubee is a seasoned team manager with a decade of experience in the tech industry. Passionate about leadership and people management, she demonstrated an unwavering commitment to advancing the careers of her team members. This commitment is deeply rooted in the belief that the success of any organization is intrinsically tied to the growth and development of its people. Holding a Ph.D. in Political Science, she brings a unique interdisciplinary perspective to leadership, which enriches her approach to team management, allowing for a holistic understanding of the complex dynamics within both the technological and human aspects of her teams.
Outside of the professional realm, Dominika indulges in a myriad of interests, including globetrotting to explore new cultures, mastering languages, and unleashing creativity through watercolour painting and calligraphy.

speakers.title: Beata Matras
speakers.content:
Beata is a Product Manager by profession, responsible for developing and maintaining the website as well as its content management system at global FinTech.

She works closely with three amazing development teams, each focusing on the front-end (what the user sees) and the back-end (how the website works).

On a daily basis, her tasks include setting goals, creating roadmaps, prioritizing tasks, participating in meetings with end-users to gather feedback and analyze their needs. She also handles communication with key stakeholders and other individuals involved in activities related to the product.

She's incredibly excited about merging tools from the product and project areas, as well as exploring the fascinating realms of communication and personal branding. She's even doing her own podcast (doing it my way by beata matras).

And when Beata is not busy being a creative genius, you can find her indulging in activities like running, riding a bike, cooking up a storm in the kitchen, and expressing herself through writing.

speakers.title: Konrad Bujak
speakers.content:
Passionate product leader with over 6 years of experience driving end-to-end product delivery and leading cross-functional teams.

In his last role, he directed a portfolio of products using Agile methodologies (and Shape-Up), resulting in a 25% boost in productivity and a 40% increase in user satisfaction. Excel at rallying teams to bring innovative visions to life, informed by rigorous A/B testing and data analysis. 4-times founder in diverse industries (Culinary tourism, Generative AI, Legal, edtech).

Eager to share lessons learned transitioning from product manager to people leader, executive, and founder. Well-versed in the mental shift required to guide teams versus individual contribution. Experienced drastic situations (i.e., after joining a company, the department people filed for quitting or physical violence in the workplace). Always seeking to mentor others, especially women, pursuing product roles in tech.
